title: A folded scalar whose lines are all blank is empty, whatever the width of the lines
notes: With no indentation indicator the content indentation is that of the first non-empty line; if there is none it is the number of spaces on the longest line (section 8.1.1.1). The three lines have 1, 2 and 3 spaces, so the indentation is 3 and every line is an empty line (production 166). The comment at column 1 ends the scalar. The value is the empty string. Compare yaml-test-suite S98Z, where a comment indented by one space is the first non-empty line and the wider blank lines before it are an error. The comment line is at column 1, below the least indentation content can have here (one more than the mapping's), so it cannot be content: it is a trailing comment line (production 169), and the scalar has no non-empty line. Compare Example 8.2, where `# detected` at the content indentation is content, and yaml-test-suite JEF9/01, where a line of three spaces is an empty line.

provenance.reference: A reader that took the indentation from the parent and read the wider blank lines as content, giving a value of line breaks and spaces.
